abilities.name: Advanced Cloak
abilities.description: Allows the ship to move at full speed while cloaked.  This ability drains 1.5 energy per second while active.

abilities.name: Cloak
abilities.description: When activated, completely hides the ship from sensor detection.  The ship must be at a complete stop to cloak, and can only move at half speed while cloaked.  Cloaking takes 7 seconds to initialize and uses 0.5 energy per second thereafter.

abilities.name: Combat Cloak
abilities.description: Eliminates the requirement for the ship to be motionless before cloaking, and doubles unmodified beam weapon base damage for 5 seconds after cloaking is disengaged.  This ability consumes 3 energy per second while active.

abilities.name: Teleport Enemy
abilities.description: Teleports enemy NPCs away from the ship.

abilities.name: Teleport Friend
abilities.description: Allows other group members within 6000 units to be teleported away from danger.

abilities.name: Teleport Self
abilities.description: Teleports the ship 5000 units in a random direction.

abilities.name: Environment Barrier
abilities.description: creates a shield around a friendly target that protects the ship from environmental effects (reducing their power by 50%) and reduces incoming damage by 5%.

abilities.name: Environment Shield
abilities.description: Creates a shield that reduces environmental effects by 100% and reduces incoming damage by 10%, reflecting up to 10 points of damage back to the attacker.  Energy damage is not reflected.

abilities.name: Greater Environment Shield
abilities.description: Creates a shield that reduces environmental effects by 100%, reduces incoming damage by 10% (reflecting up to 25 points back to attacker), and converts 5% (maximum of 10 points) of incoming damage to reactor energy.  Energy damage is not reflected or converted.

abilities.name: Group Cloak
abilities.description: Completely cloaks all group members within 1000 units.  Warp travel is allowed while cloaked.  This ability drains 10 energy per second while active.

abilities.name: Group Leech
abilities.description: Drains shields from a single hostile and transfers a portion of that as energy to the player and group.

abilities.name: Group Leeching Sphere
abilities.description: Drains shields from all targets within 3000 units of the target and transfers a portion of that as energy to player and group.

abilities.name: Group Stealth
abilities.description: Cloaks the ship and creates a stealth field around all group members within 1000 units.  Warp travel is allowed while cloaked.  This ability drains 6 energy per second while active.
